locations.title: Clues

Scattered around the ground floor of the opera house, and can only be interacted with during the [Madama Machine](https://mapgenie.io/stellar-blade/maps/xion-city?locationIds=465826) side quest. The clues consist of:

- 2x blue devices on the ground
- 1x corpse near the seats holding an entry token
